description: An ultrasonic distance sensor: a TRIG pulse starts a measurement, and the ECHO pin's pulse width encodes the measured distance.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, TRIG is a digital output from the microcontroller (send a >=10us pulse to start a measurement), ECHO is a digital input back to the microcontroller (its pulse length in microseconds / 58 = distance in cm).
